name: Google Sheets content calendar to sprkly

parameters.content:
## Post from a Google Sheet with sprkly

### How it works
- Every 15 minutes it reads the rows with Status **Approved**.
- It checks each row: a Row ID, a caption, a time that has not come yet, at least one account, and web links for media.
- A bad row gets Status **Error** and a plain reason.
- A good row goes to sprkly as a scheduled post. External ID `sheet-<Row ID>` means a re-run never posts twice.
- The row gets Status **Scheduled**, the sprkly Post ID and the time.
- When the post goes out, the row gets **Published** and the link. When it fails, **Failed** and the reason.

### Setup
- Needs the community node `n8n-nodes-sprkly`. Install steps: https://github.com/ahlanlhw/n8n-nodes-sprkly#install
- n8n has not verified this node, so it runs on self-hosted n8n only.
- Tested on n8n 2.47.7 with n8n-nodes-sprkly 0.1.0.
- Make a sheet with these columns: Row ID, Status, Caption, Schedule Time, Accounts, Media URL, sprkly Post ID, Scheduled For, Link, Error.
- Add your sprkly API credential to the 4 sprkly nodes. API docs: https://sprkly.app/docs/api
- Add your Google Sheets credential to the 3 sheet nodes, and pick your sheet in each.
- Set your time zone in Workflow settings. Times in the sheet use it.

### Customization
- Change how often it runs in **Every 15 minutes**.
- Add a Title column for TikTok and YouTube, and map it in **Schedule post in sprkly**.

## Read and check approved rows
Every 15 minutes, only rows with Status Approved. Each row needs a Row ID, a caption, a time that has not come yet, and an account. A row that fails gets Status Error and the reason.

## Match accounts
One call to sprkly per run gets your accounts. Write each one as platform:handle, like instagram:myhandle or telegram:My channel. Put commas between several.

## This posts for real
An empty time means "post now" in the sprkly API. This workflow refuses that: a row with no time stops at **Check each row** and never gets here.

## Write the result back
External ID sheet-<Row ID> stops double posts. A repeat writes the first post's ID, not a new post. Any other error goes in the Error column.

## Track what happened
sprkly checks for posts that went out or failed. The row is found by its Row ID, taken from the post's External ID. Posts made outside this sheet are skipped.
